raw_response:
I need to analyze the duration of notes in this ABC notation passage.

Looking at the passage:
- L: 1/8 means the default note length is an eighth note (1/8)
- M: C means common time (4/4)

Voice 1: `_d=Bc=d fedc`
- Each letter without a duration modifier represents the default length of 1/8
- All notes are eighth notes: _d, =B, c=d, f, e, d, c
- Each eighth note = 0.5 quarter notes

Voice 2: `[=A,8C8E8^F8]`
- The numbers after each note indicate the duration in terms of the default note length
- The "8" means 8 times the default length (1/8)
- 8 × (1/8) = 1 whole note = 4 quarter notes
- This is a chord where all notes have the same duration of 8 eighth notes

The longest note duration is the whole note chord in Voice 2, which equals 4 quarter notes.

{"answer": "4"}
